stem.en: A person feels their heartbeat most strongly on the left side of their chest. What does this actually tell you about the heart's location?
stem.et: Inimene tunneb oma südamelööki kõige tugevamalt rindkere vasakul poolel. Mida see tegelikult südame asukoha kohta ütleb?

label.en: Very little about the heart's overall location -- the heart sits roughly in the center of the chest but is tilted so more of it projects toward the left, which is why the strongest beat is felt there.
label.et: Väga vähe südame üldise asukoha kohta -- süda asub rindkere keskel, kuid on kaldu, nii et suurem osa sellest ulatub vasakule, mistõttu tuntakse just seal kõige tugevamat lööki.

label.en: It confirms that the heart is anatomically located on the left side of the chest, not the center.
label.et: See kinnitab, et süda asub anatoomiliselt rindkere vasakul poolel, mitte keskel.

label.en: It reflects that only the left side of the heart is actively pumping at any given moment, alternating with the right side.
label.et: See peegeldab, et igal hetkel pumpab aktiivselt ainult südame vasak pool, vaheldudes parema poolega.

label.en: It reflects where the brain sends its strongest signal to trigger the heartbeat, which is on the left side of the body.
label.et: See peegeldab, kuhu aju saadab südamelöögi käivitamiseks oma tugevaima signaali, mis on keha vasakul poolel.
